ck: nantaranancari laksnikaratalanpocalalaniyapatanpucan prananani hayakrivan tevatacakravartinan 1 srinatanantatirtaryacarananpuruhatvayan siventratisiropusanataratapivataye 2 cayatirtanunin natva paktyasnakan kurunapi tatvaprakasikavyakyan yatanati vivrnahe 3 praripsitakrantaviknaparisanaptyatiprayocanakanavikitasistacaranunitasrutiprananakan paratevataprananalaksanan nankalanacaran krantakarta cayatirtacaryascikirsitan nirtisati ranaya iti ranananiti ‘krtalyuto pahulan’ iti kartrarte lyuta snaranat kartari lyut ranarananasyEva nanyatve hetunaha kuna-nanikyeti kuna eva nanikyani tesan nantananityarta tatvaprakasikavyakyaniti prahnaninansasahitavetantavisayatitatva-prakasikavyakyanityarta karisyana iti parasanavetakriyapalapitayina parasnEpatena sisyanucikrksaya kranto nirniyata iti sucayati upatikantana nantaranancari nanu kinartanitan prakarananarapyate pakavatpatE? na ca vetantanan saninansanan visayaprayocanatisvarupanirnayartanarapyate, tanirnayasca vetantatO cicnasunan pravrtyarta, pravrtisca cnanasanpatanatvara noksaparyavasayiniti vacyan noksasya isvaraprasatEkasatyatvena cnananapeksanatityasankyaha paranatnana ityatina na casaksatkrtosO prasitatityantena krantena civasya tukatyanarta paranesvaraprasatatrte napakacatiti sanpanta nanu tukateranantativatanivrti kin na syat ? ityata aha anyatakara iti anantativana svapavikatvan antakaranatarnatvatukatinaniti pava tarhi nayinata iva tukatinan nityatvan syatiti netyaha paranartata iti tukatinan svarupena antakarane paranartatvat tatanu-santatrtvasya tukitvasya cive paranartatvana kasyapi nityatvanityarta nanu tasyanartasyaninitakatve svarupanantativatsvapavikatvan syat saninitakatve ca ninitasyapi ninitantarapeksayananavasta syatityata aha anatyavityakanakarneti saninitakatvepi ninitasyanati-tvananavastetyarta avitya pavarupacnanan kano raka karna kanyatikarna avityaya svarupenanatitvan itarayostu pravahata iti trastavyan svarupatonatitvapariskara nanu kinitananatitvan nana kin prakapavapratiyokitvan ? kin va karanasunyatvan ? atyepi kin svaprakapavapratiyokitvan ? anyaprakapava-pratiyokitvan va ? prakapavanatrapratiyokitvan va ? atyepi kin svaprakapava prasita ? uta na ? atye katanayan na tatpratiyoki syat ?
